call_points.text: Management targets double-digit top-line and bottom-line growth for FY27 during the consolidation phase.
Garmenting Q1 order books are completely full, with booking underway for the latter half of Q2.
High input costs for Merino wool and flax pose challenges to gross margin expansion despite premiumization.
Exiting sleepwear business eliminates an annual EBITDA drag of approximately ₹20 Cr.
Network expansion in FY27 planned at >100 gross store additions, net 30 to 40 after rationalizing non-performing doors.
Garmenting saw strong growth on account of demand recovery post US-India Trade Deal and new customers onboarded in anticipation of UK & EU FTA implementation.
Entering the 'Year of Consolidation' for FY27, shifting focus to a high-performance culture while emphasizing sustainable profitability.
B2B and Garmenting segments were impacted by US tariff uncertainty, managed via strong domestic focus and diversifying into UK and EU.

operating_notes.text: FY26 total income crossed ₹7,000 Cr mark for the first time.
Factory utilizations exceeded 90%, with some operating at 95% plus, driving scale benefits and lower opex.
Discontinuing sleepwear business removes an annual drag of ₹20 Cr from EBITDA.
Net working capital days improved to 82 days in Sep-2026 from 105 days in Sep-2025.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,776.45 Cr (+18.9% YoY), net loss ₹52.06 Cr (against a loss of ₹44.95 Cr a year earlier).
Raymond Lifestyle reported FY26 total income of ₹7,034 Cr and Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,810 Cr, crossing the ₹7,000 Cr historic annual mark.
Raymond Lifestyle held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for double-digit FY27 revenue and profit growth while consolidating retail stores.
GAUTAM HARI SINGHANIA declared no new encumbrances on Raymond Lifestyle Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,075.1 Cr (+13.2% YoY), net profit ₹67.53 Cr (-10.2% YoY).
Raymond Lifestyle reported Q2FY27 total income of ₹2,125 Cr (+14% YoY) and net profit of ₹68 Cr (-10% YoY).
